run_prompt_optimization: run the iterative prompt optimization loop to find and save optimized system prompts
generate_predictions: generate model predictions for a list of prompts against a dataset with optional RAG
score_predictions: score model predictions against ground truth answers using a scoring prompt template
rewrite_prompts: rewrite system prompts based on critique of predictions and scores using beam search
parse_score_strings: parse score strings from model output and extract numeric scores with regex
